<!-- r1-handoff-20261008 -->
## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-10-08

Execution is stopped at the user's request. All workers are settled; active R1 runtime, SSH and fetch commands joined; Linux111's R1 reservation is genuinely released. **Resume from the [durable handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md)**, then refresh live heads, dependencies, reviews/CI and host ownership. The guide contains exact source branches, failures, source-only acceptance, unexecuted checks, preserved evidence and the restart order. Earlier checkpoint status below is historical. No product or performance acceptance is implied, and this ticket remains open.

**This node:** [draft #5125](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5125) preserves existing pushed headc9f85aeb. Historical component normal/race4K/16K evidence exists; inclusive16K measurement is11,972,744B including601,920 closure bytes, with13 legacy rows UNKNOWN. #5037/#5054 remain unadopted/unmerged and their final ABI unfrozen. Resolve the exact required shared-owner subset and constructor/publication overlap, then validate whole C/P<=0.85 allocation and25% avoidable-materialization goals on real predecessor identity. Keep broader external ownership intact.

<!-- /r1-handoff-20261008 -->

## Accepted execution contract v2 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is1000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal and ownership

Parent [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090); accepted #5091 selects the exact source-bound checkpoint allocation contract. Primary deliverable: **PR**. Own the R1 checkpoint dependency-manifest encoding/materialization and associated temporary-lifetime residual; #5015 retains shared physical closure/capture/coalescing, #5016 retains recovery membership/pruning. Do not take over their active PRs or silently make their whole umbrella a prerequisite.

At runtime source `797d783b21b36e7a0e540cd8190b4ec5921711fe`, `DependencyManifestV1.Materialize` allocates a new 4 KiB image for each page (`TreeDB/internal/rootpublication/durable_format_v1.go:320`). #5091's source-bound profile observed about 56 KiB beneath that materialization after a 4,096-row load and 64 generic updates; that is a concrete allocation site, not exclusive attribution of the historical 1.11→3.83 MB checkpoint increase. Current #5015 selected refinements do not explicitly own this encoding scratch. Inclusive/async profile shares must not be added.

## Selected architecture and complete packet

Use a bounded owned encoding/append lifetime in the existing dependency-manifest publisher. Consolidate repeated manifest/page encoding, temporary copies and scratch only where actual sink ownership and publication lifetime prove reuse safe. Do not introduce a second durable manifest, root authority, persistent cache or publication engine. Preserve exact entry order, digest, page IDs/checksums, final page zero padding, both independently recoverable metas, registered namespace/frontier dependencies and accepted-error/abort balancing.

Start with an ownership/format invariant: a multi-page manifest must round-trip with exact bytes/checksums through retaining and synchronous sinks, including the partial final page, callback failure and caller reuse. Capture a meaningful failing allocation/ownership contract before the changed path, or explicitly use adequate existing characterization for a pure internal refactor. Never assume an arbitrary custom AppendPageSink releases input at return unless its contract guarantees that; unsupported sinks retain the existing owned-page route.

Audit all implicated per-checkpoint/per-page allocations and lifetime, identifying required durable/output buffers versus avoidable temporary images, manifest entry/frontier clones and encoding scratch. Select only causes proved on this exact checkpoint schedule. Coordinate shared publication file overlap with #5015 before edits; a separate cause discovered in its scope goes to that owner, not a duplicate implementation.

Update dependency publication/storage/recovery/verification docs in the same PR. Run focused format/ownership, root activation/abort, reopen/older-meta recovery, affected modeled power-loss and race coverage. Add no migration subsystem: pre-alpha selected format changes may refuse old directories with rebuild instructions, but prefer preserving this format when bounded streaming suffices.

## Frozen performance-objective contract

Before any runtime candidate, capture a stable repeated unprofiled baseline with this exact schedule: 4,096-row R1 typed-row fixture, 64 identical generic field updates, native backend, flushed/durable mode, stats enabled, one final FlushAll followed by Checkpoint. Setup/updates and the actual enclosing checkpoint boundary are separately reported. Repeat the same matched checkpoint schedule at 16,384 rows as a scaling guardrail. The preliminary 4k CPU-capture-associated observation was 41.21 ms / 482,832 B; it is not a reliable matched qualification baseline and must not be relabeled as one.

Target: at most **0.85× matched baseline median checkpoint elapsed and allocation bytes** at the frozen 4k schedule, explain scaling at 16k, and eliminate demonstrated avoidable page-image amplification. Report objects, encoded pages/bytes, syncs, retained/peak memory where relevant, actual stats overhead and asynchronous coordinator work. No inventing exclusive shares from overlapping profiles or comparing unequal update counts/checkpoint states. Require meaningful whole-call improvement in addition to a helper allocation reduction. If stable controls do not reproduce an avoidable cost or the target fails, keep the parent gate open, revise the selected mechanism/owner from evidence, and do not substitute a smaller successful microbenchmark.

Required correctness/performance gates include source/binary/toolchain/fixture/ACK/ownership identity, actual ordinary production path proof, equivalent before/after commands on the same host, and no unexplained material latency/allocation/storage regression. Full retained qualification follows reviewed/landed #5096 then frozen #5097; this runtime packet still needs focused matched evidence before merge.

Dependencies: accepted #5091 decision. It is a required runtime predecessor of #5096 and #5097. Use an isolated topic branch, complete mature exact-head independent/required available AI review and current-head repository CI, then merge within the authorized graph. No partial checkpoint residual closure.

Reassess after the first stable current-source checkpoint attribution/control: freeze the exact encoding/sink ownership change, preserve negative/noisy findings, and explicitly route any shared closure cause to #5015 without assuming its unpublished work is landed.

## Source reassessment — whole-checkpoint mechanism remains open

[Current source reassessment](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5099#issuecomment-6037141107) supersedes any interpretation that a reusable page image alone is the selected completion mechanism. Actual retained final manifests contain9/25 pages at4k/16k; the corresponding one-image saving ceiling is below the frozen15% whole-call allocation target at both sizes. The ordinary path already streams cached entry bytes, and the cold-build counter interval does not prove those bytes were allocated inside the exact checkpoint timer.

The local owned encoding/lifetime architecture above remains a candidate to assess, with its format and sink obligations intact. No runtime implementation or performance acceptance is selected yet. Required next decision is the [scoped #5015 owner inquiry](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5015#issuecomment-6037147364) into ordinary durability capture/coalescing and authoritative physical sync-frontier sharing. This is not an automatic dependency on that entire umbrella or a takeover of its active PR. Record any actually selected required shared slice before implementation.

Keep all20 controls, failed/noisy groups and traced diagnostics. Preserve the ONE complete timed public FlushAll+Checkpoint, unchanged64 updates/default schedule, both4k/16k populations and original elapsed/allocation/avoidable-materialization targets. No pre-drain, timer/default adjustment, favorable-cut selection or helper-only closure.

## Selected adjacent slice — captured full-closure reuse (2026-10-08)

The [live #5015 owner handoff](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5015#issuecomment-6049448354) selects a narrow provisional implementation at PR #5037 head `9011f52f0c7f12346254a5dbf41461ae9b4af943`: preserve the primary pointer projection required before pointer-backed descriptor decoding, then reuse the second full explicit-root projection's exact count result after successful physical registration and fresh private-set rebind. Remove the duplicate third full count projection. Do not add primary counts, cache the result across candidates, or change resource capture authority.

Preserve root-ID deduplication and per-entry count multiplicity, raw outer-leaf dependencies, captured index/commit/user/system stamps, corruption/quarantine/failure behavior, and all consumer lifetimes. Test the actual candidate page-visit counter against primary plus one full traversal; independently verify counts and external dependencies for pager/value-log leaves and pointer-backed aliased descriptors. Retain stale-evidence, abort, exact namespace registration, older-meta/reopen and race gates. Send the owner the exact diff and test contract before integration.

This separate #5099 branch requires **PR #5037 to land before integration/merge**, then final-base revalidation. It does not modify the owner's branches or frozen #5028 campaign. Broader coalescing, admission and authoritative cross-producer sync-frontier sharing remain inquiry-only. This is a selected causal slice, not whole-issue completion: the unchanged ONE public FlushAll+Checkpoint boundary, 64 updates, both 4k/16k populations, original 0.85 elapsed/allocation targets, avoidable-materialization target and noise rules still govern #5099. If the real checkpoint path does not exercise fallback or the whole-call gates fail, keep this node open and reassess the remaining architecture.
